providers.description: Contains comprehensive information about 450 healthcare providers in the network. This table includes provider identification details (Provider_ID, Provider_Name, Specialty), location information (County, City, ZIP_Code), network organization (Provider_Pod), contract details (Contract_Type, Contract_Start_Date, Contract_End_Date), capacity and availability metrics (Panel_Size, Accepting_New_Patients, Years_In_Network, Avg_Wait_Days), financial performance indicators (Avg_Cost_Per_Visit, Revenue_Leakage_Percent, Cost_Tier), quality and satisfaction scores (Quality_Score, Patient_Satisfaction_Score, HEDIS_Compliance_Score, Readmission_Rate), behavioral and clinical metrics (In_Network_Referral_Rate, Appropriate_Imaging_Rate, Generic_Prescribing_Rate, Preventive_Care_Completion_Rate, Referral_Pattern_Quality_Score), utilization metrics (Utilization_Rate), and program participation flags (VBC_Participation, Directory_Accuracy, Rural_Provider). This is the primary table for analyzing individual provider performance, identifying high and low performers, understanding provider distribution across geographies and specialties, and evaluating contract arrangements.

members.description: Contains detailed information about 15,000 health plan members enrolled in the network. This table includes member identification and demographics (Member_ID, Age, Gender, County), plan enrollment details (Plan_Type, Length_of_Membership_Years), care coordination information (PCP_Assigned, Care_Manager_Assigned), utilization patterns (Network_Utilization, ER_Visits_Last_Year, Specialist_Visits_Last_Year, PCP_Visits_Last_Year, Days_Since_Last_PCP_Visit), health status and risk (Risk_Level, Chronic_Conditions_Count, Readmission_Risk_Score), cost metrics (Annual_Medical_Cost, Predicted_Cost_Next_Year), quality and care gap measures (Preventive_Care_Complete, Care_Gaps_Count), member experience indicators (Member_Satisfaction_Score, Access_Complaints_Count, Avg_Travel_Distance_Miles). This table is essential for population health management, risk stratification, cost prediction, identifying members needing intervention, analyzing utilization patterns, and understanding member satisfaction and access issues.

referral_network.description: Contains 1,995 records documenting provider-to-provider referral relationships and patterns within and outside the network. This table includes referral identification (Referral_ID), the referring provider (Referring_Provider_ID), the provider being referred to (Referred_To_Provider_ID), referral volume metrics (Referral_Count_Last_Year), network status (In_Network indicating whether the referral stayed within the payer network or went out-of-network), cost information (Avg_Cost_Per_Referral), timing data (Referral_Date), and specialty information (Specialty_Referred_To). This table is critical for analyzing referral patterns, identifying network leakage points, understanding care coordination between providers, evaluating which providers send or receive the most referrals, and calculating the financial impact of out-of-network referrals.

monthly_metrics.description: Contains 24 months of time-series data tracking network-wide performance metrics from January 2023 to December 2024. This table includes time period identification (Month, Date), network adequacy and accuracy measures (Network_Adequacy_Score, Directory_Accuracy_Rate), utilization patterns (OON_Utilization_Rate indicating out-of-network usage), access metrics (Avg_Wait_Time_Days), provider retention (Provider_Attrition_Rate), member experience (Member_Complaints_Count), cost trends (Cost_PMPM representing Per Member Per Month costs), quality and appropriateness measures (In_Network_Referral_Rate, Appropriate_Imaging_Rate, Generic_Prescribing_Rate), and predictive analytics performance (Predicted_Readmissions, Actual_Readmissions, Prediction_Accuracy). This table is used for trend analysis, monitoring performance over time, identifying seasonal patterns, tracking improvements or deterioration in key metrics, and evaluating the effectiveness of network interventions.

provider_pods.description: Contains information about 4 provider care coordination groups or network pods that organize providers by geographic region. This table includes pod identification (Pod_Name), geographic coverage (Counties_Served listing which counties each pod serves), provider composition (Total_Providers, Primary_Care_Providers, Specialist_Providers), aggregate quality metrics (Avg_Quality_Score), behavioral performance indicators (Avg_In_Network_Referral_Rate, Avg_Revenue_Leakage), scale and capacity metrics (Total_Panel_Size representing combined patients served), program participation (VBC_Participation_Rate indicating Value-Based Care adoption), and financial opportunity (Estimated_Annual_Savings_Potential). The four pods are Capital Region IDS, Saratoga Springs Hub, Hudson Valley Network, and North Country Coalition. This table is essential for understanding regional network organization, comparing performance across geographic areas, and identifying regional optimization opportunities.

behavior_opportunities.description: Contains analysis of 12 medical specialties identifying behavior change opportunities and improvement potential to increase in-network referral rates and reduce costs. This table includes specialty identification (Specialty covering all 12 specialties in the network), provider counts (Total_Providers in each specialty), performance metrics (Current_In_Network_Referral_Rate, Target_In_Network_Referral_Rate set at 0.85 for all specialties), performance gap analysis (Gap_Percentage showing how far current performance is from target), provider segmentation (Providers_Needing_Intervention requiring immediate action, Providers_Needing_Enablement needing training/support, High_Performers already meeting targets), financial impact (Estimated_Annual_Savings if all providers reach target), implementation planning (Recommended_Intervention_Duration set at 6 months, Priority_Level categorized as Critical/High/Medium). This table is used to prioritize network improvement initiatives, identify which specialties offer the greatest savings potential, and plan targeted interventions.

high_leakage_providers.description: Contains the top 50 providers with the highest revenue leakage due to out-of-network referral patterns. This table includes provider identification (Provider_ID, Provider_Name, Specialty), location information (County, Provider_Pod), leakage metrics (Revenue_Leakage_Percent indicating the proportion of potential revenue lost, In_Network_Referral_Rate showing current performance), provider scale (Panel_Size), financial impact (Estimated_Annual_Revenue_Loss in dollars), and contract details (Contract_Type). These providers represent the highest-priority targets for intervention as they are causing significant financial losses through referrals that leave the network. This table is used to identify quick-win opportunities for revenue recovery, prioritize provider outreach and education efforts, and quantify the financial impact of referral behavior on network performance.

high_risk_members.description: Contains 3,744 members identified as high-risk and requiring intensive care management or monitoring. This is a filtered subset of the Members table focusing on individuals with chronic conditions, rising risk profiles, or high likelihood of adverse outcomes. This table includes member identification and demographics (Member_ID, County, Age, Gender), risk classification (Risk_Level categorized as Chronic/Maintenance/Rising Risk, Readmission_Risk_Score), health complexity (Chronic_Conditions_Count), cost information (Annual_Medical_Cost, Predicted_Cost_Next_Year indicating expected future spend), quality measures (Care_Gaps_Count showing unmet care needs), care management status (Care_Manager_Assigned indicating if intensive management is in place), and network utilization (Network_Utilization showing in-network vs out-of-network patterns). This table is critical for care management programs, identifying members needing intervention, preventing avoidable hospitalizations, and managing the highest-cost segment of the member population.

data_dictionary.description: Contains metadata describing each of the 8 main data sheets in the database. This table includes sheet identification (Sheet_Name), descriptive information (Description providing a brief overview of what each sheet contains and its purpose), and size metrics (Record_Count showing how many records exist in each sheet). The sheets documented are Providers (450 records), Members (15,000 records), Referral_Network (1,995 records), Monthly_Metrics (24 records), Provider_Pods (4 records), Behavior_Opportunities (12 records), High_Leakage_Providers (50 records), and High_Risk_Members (3,744 records). This table serves as a high-level guide to understanding the database structure and helps users navigate to the appropriate data source for their analysis needs.
